events.headline: Oil prices mixed (WTI -0.44% to ~$90/bbl, Brent +0.36% to ~$99.6/bbl) as traders weigh hours-long US-Iran talks at UN sidelines against Trump's renewed threat to annihilate Iran absent a deal; Saudi Arabia reportedly preparing to restart its East-West pipeline by Saturday

Trump told the UN General Assembly he faces a "big decision" on Iran -- strike a peace deal or "annihilate the Islamic Republic" -- while predicting a deal after the Nov 3 midterms; US envoys held a 3-hour meeting with Iranian officials same day

Nasdaq 100 posted its first record close since June as chipmaker rally continued; PHLX Semiconductor Index (SOX) up over 14% in the last 5 sessions, with Korean chip stocks (Samsung, SK Hynix) also gaining on AI enthusiasm
